course.title: Probability and Statistical Analysis
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: The manufacture of the X-15 steel-belted radial truck tire claims that the mean mileage the tire can be driven before the tread wears out is 60,000 miles. The population standard deviation of the mileage is 5,000 miles. Crosset Truck Company bought 48 tires and found that the mean mileage for its truck is 59,500 miles. Is Crosset's experience different from that claimed by the manufacturer at the 0.05 significance level?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
